_comment: Recorded on 2026-10-06: `otelcol-contrib validate --config=<file>` (darwin_arm64, sha256 checked against catalog/) run on each case's text with an empty environment. stdout was empty for every case. The echo-* cases were recorded the same way: a requirement's phrasing put where the collector echoes the text (an invalid key, a map key, a quoted value, an id, a type). Among them, echo-headers-key-*, echo-start-at-stat, echo-encoding-*, echo-operator-type-stat, echo-error-mode-stat and echo-detector-* hold a value or key that closes the collector's unescaped '…' early, or one it echoes unquoted. Some cases name their `environment`: `empty`, as above, or `service`, run as the service runs the collector: on the text as `_prepare` leaves it (providers neutralised) with the service's environment (the allowlist, VALIDATION_ENV_OVERRIDES and the `${env:}` placeholders). req-* are real requirement outputs (with reqs and k8sattr-node, the sources of the requirement templates); bypass-* are bypasses of the submitted-text guard (through the collector's own substitution, and through texts PyYAML refuses that the collector reads).
